title: Regulation of Gene Expression in Kluyveromyces lactis
summary: This cluster revolves around the regulation of gene expression in Kluyveromyces lactis, particularly focusing on the JUB1 gene and its variants. JUB1 controls the expression of GAL1 and recruits RNAP, while its variant JUB1-X synTF expresses various genes, including APSK, ATPS, and PPK2. The cluster also includes various chemical compounds, such as IPTG, PAPS, and ATP, which are involved in the regulation of gene expression. Additionally, the cluster includes several other genes, including PPK2CpaN, PPA, and HIS3, which are transcribed by RNAP. The regulation of gene expression in this cluster is complex and involves multiple interactions between genes and chemical compounds.
